description: This file contains helper functions for Row-Level Security (RLS) in a PostgreSQL database, specifically for use with Supabase. It defines functions to check user roles and permissions such as 'has_role' and 'is_admin'.

methods.name: public.has_role
methods.description: Checks if the current user has a specified role by querying the user_roles and roles tables.

methods.name: public.is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the 'admin' role by invoking has_role('admin').
